metadata.title: Server Attestation and Trust

props.name: capability

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Server, workload, and platform execution technology domain.

props.name: technology-platform
props.remarks: Hardware roots of trust, secure boot, measured boot, and workload attestation services.

metadata.remarks:
Server Attestation and Trust defines the capability to establish cryptographic and measurable confidence in the integrity of servers and workloads. This includes verification of firmware, boot process, host platform state, and workload execution context. Attestation provides a stronger trust signal than configuration or monitoring alone.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern is the authoritative anchor for SSPPs, standards, procedures, guidelines, and assurance related to server and workload trust establishment. Controls are scoped to trust verification only and intentionally exclude configuration enforcement, patch management, and runtime threat detection.

components.title: Hardware Root of Trust
components.description: Use of hardware-based mechanisms to anchor trust in server platforms.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Manipulation or compromise of platform firmware to undermine trust.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Anchor trust in hardware-backed cryptographic roots.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Use cryptographic mechanisms to establish trusted execution foundations.

components.title: Boot Attestation
components.description: Verification of server boot integrity, including firmware, bootloader, and kernel stages.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Pre-boot manipulation to persist malicious code.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Verify software and firmware integrity during system startup.

components.title: Host and Platform Integrity
components.description: Measurement and verification of server host platform state beyond initial boot.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Tampering with system measurements or integrity data.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Ongoing verification of host integrity measurements.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Continuously or periodically verify host platform integrity measurements.

components.title: Workload Attestation
components.description: Verification that workloads are executing on trusted hosts and in approved execution contexts.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Execution of workloads in untrusted or modified runtime environments.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Validation of workload identity and execution context prior to authorization.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Use attestation results to authorize workload execution or access.
